In October 2022, he was announced as the winner of the 2022 Arnold Palmer Award, given to the season's most outstanding rookie. Prior to turning professional, Cameron attended Wake Forest University where he earned a degree in Economics. Young's father is a PGA Professional at Sleepy Hollow Country Club in Briarcliff Manor, New York, and has been Cameron's golf coach for much of his life.
